_comment: Case id -> the Laravel route that renders the same screen, plus the state it renders it in.
Keys are the prototype's own file names under design-reference/{desktop,mobile}.
An unmapped case returns 404 naming the missing key. It never falls back to a guess: a
fixture that silently rendered the wrong page would produce a green gate against a screen
`auth: admin` signs the request in as the first seeded administrator. The admin panel's own
sign-in flow is V3 work and does not exist yet, so without it those four screens redirect to
the login page and would be measured as that page four times over.
404             has no route of its own — any unmatched path renders it.
check-ergebnis  needs a token from a real check; there is no seeded row to build one from,
and inventing one would measure an error page under the right name.
